title: From Disguised Escape to the Kiratpur Muster Roll

blocks.text: This page records the cruel aftermath of the mountain flight: provisions are scarce, even money cannot reliably buy grain, and many Singhs die from hunger before they can find a secure route away from the cordon. The survivors endure not only military pursuit but a landscape in which ordinary sustenance has been cut off.

Those who manage to live do so by concealment and improvisation. Some bind up their hair, alter their appearance, and move quietly through Mandi and Kullu until they finally reached Kiratpur in disguise instead of marching openly as warriors.

The page closes the episode with a reckoning in the sixth month, distinguishing the dead from those who straggled through alive. It serves as a muster roll of loss before the narrative turns from escape and survival toward those marked for death in the slaughter.
